formal.text: The Boy Scouts of America have been implementing measures to make their programs more inclusive in recent years. Last year, the organization announced that it would welcome girls for the first time in its century-long history. As part of this initiative, the organization's flagship program, previously known as the Boy Scouts, will now be called Scouts BSA, effective from February 2019. Effie Delimarkos, a spokeswoman for the organization, stated that 'Scouts BSA perfectly represents the new, inclusive program for older Scouts that the Boy Scouts of America is proud to offer.' Michael Surbaugh, Chief Scout Executive, indicated that several names were considered, with the aim of finding one that evokes inclusivity.
